name: seo-serp-intent
summary: Analyze bounded search-result pages to classify intent, SERP composition, result overlap, and page-type fit with source-labeled evidence.
inputs: query set or approved seed-derived queries
writes: Home.md review link when review is required
external_reads: ranking-page content within the approved SERP-intent read
approval_gates: provider_availability: run a bounded read-only availability check against approved integration surfaces; do not reveal secrets or probe arbitrary services
external_read: ask before live SERP observation or ranking-page reads; ranking-page inspection is included once this approval is granted and does not require a second competitor-analysis approval
provider_data: paid or credentialed calls require applicable approval
vault_write: save only to a resolved project, client, or prospect context when authorized
external_mutation: publishing, CMS, repository, production, and provider configuration changes are out of scope
done_when: query set, client context, domain, market, location, language, device, search engine, date, and result depth are explicit
provider status is recorded for each declared source
live SERP and ranking-page reads had external-read approval
intent is classified from observed SERP composition
result types, SERP features, local/freshness signals, and overlap are recorded
existing-page fit and recommended page type are explicit
observations, provider data, heuristics, hypotheses, and recommendations are distinct
durable artifact uses project/client/prospect routing and review frontmatter
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred with an actionable reason
verification: verify unavailable providers produced no fabricated SERP data
verify live external reads had approval
verify ranking-page inspection did not trigger a redundant competitor approval
verify intent was not inferred from query text alone
verify no ranking, traffic, revenue, conversion, or AI-visibility guarantee is made
verify no copy, metadata prose, CMS change, publishing action, or production mutation occurred
verify changed Markdown/frontmatter and Home review registration when applicable
